name: Hidden Pit (BB)

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

stealth.details: (or DC 0 Perception check if the trapdoor is disabled or broken)

disable: DC 12 Thievery check to remove the trapdoor.

items.name: Pitfall
items.text: If a creature walks onto the trap door, that creature falls in unless it succeeds at a Reflex save to grab hold of the edge. The pit is 20 feet deep, dealing 10 bludgeoning damage to anyone who falls to the bottom.

text: A wooden trapdoor covers a 10-foot square pit that's 20 feet deep.
